activation.enforcementMeaning: Complete strict profile enforcement remains pending. M6 installs a bounded original-IR typing API and checked emission entry; compiler qualification, runtime typing, provider acceptance and profile activation retain separate evidence. Current ps-0.9-r3 syntax selection does not activate strict SH/1 or full Standard/PSCV conformance.
activation.selectedByPsconfigMeaning: This flag describes strict PSC0-SH/1 activation. The current sourceGrammar edition is selected independently.

authoring.sourceMeaning: Handwritten PSC1-compatible .lean parsed by the portable Lean frontend. R's immutable implementation remains A-consumable. F's required authoring seed is the qualified, cold-recovered, explicitly selected R compiler. Current .ps uses its independently versioned new-only grammar.

currentConstraints.form: Explicit result type on a match-valued let initializer.
currentConstraints.scope: Existing expected-type requirement of the PSC match elaborator; not a new M6 language rule.

currentConstraints.form: In authored compiler .lean, bind a typed lambda to an explicitly typed local, then pass the local by name.
currentConstraints.scope: Existing bounded Lean-frontend source constraint, retained by F. Current .ps accepts grouped typed callbacks; omitted domains and general expected-type inference remain unsupported.

currentConstraints.form: F removes the three scoped CompilerIr/Check.lean aliases and projects options/state directly while preserving root structural matches.
currentConstraints.scope: Requires a qualified, recoverable, explicitly selected projection-capable R successor; the typed alias remains the historical A workaround, not the current F requirement.

authoring.punctuationScope: Current proofScript inputs and canonical output use ps-0.9-r3. F keeps .lean authoritative and does not change the grammar; its authored projection forms require the qualified selected R seed.

principle: Compiler-owned normalization makes ordinary authoring source lower to a small stable core; a profile string is not capability evidence.

capabilities.proposal: Retain the owned Lean frontend for portable compiler source, with immutable R source A-consumable and F authored under explicitly selected R. Use only the current ps-0.9-r3 bounded syntax for current proofScript parsing and canonical printing, with explicit public signatures.
One new-only current .ps lexer/parser/printer and atomic active-source/tooling migration to the bounded supplied-reference subset; no current legacy grammar mode.
supported: non-explicit declaration prefix followed by one nonempty typed comma parameter group
constructor headers using the same explicit group ownership
native typed lambda binder sequences and grouped typed callbacks
distinct adjacent call groups, native whitespace argument chains and grouped callees
comma record values, braced single-term definitions and existing flat matches
annotated parameterless const and positive-arity function aliases
leading BOM and CRLF with original UTF-8 byte offsets
refused: legacy semicolon separators and repeated explicit declaration groups
tabs or lone CR outside comments/literals; repeated or nonleading BOM
unconsumed source and unsupported source commands
omitted required annotations, empty declaration parameter groups and untyped lambdas
default parameters, named arguments, tuples and generic do
arbitrary result projections and unsupported dependent/contract syntax

emptyCall.syntax: An explicit empty .app argument list is preserved through parsing and printing, including beneath another application.
emptyCall.unit: f(()) supplies Unit; f() is never rewritten to Unit.
emptyCall.elaboration: emptyCallUnsupported until a separate completion/default capability has real metadata and semantics.

qualification.fullClosureRoundTrip: N1 only; supplied raw closure manifest; canonical Lean correspondence and new PS idempotence
qualification.canonicalArtifactBinding: Hash N1's already translated canonical source artifact and require exact C2/C3 surface product equality.

capabilities.proposal: Non-indexed regular ADTs, immutable structures, List/Option/Except/Prod with closed runtime layout.
Top-level rank-1 generic functions; monomorphic runtime closures, captures, partial applications and function results.
Recognized child/predecessor of one structural major with unchanged fixed parameters.

Typed generalization of nondependent varying value parameters into a function-valued motive; canonical internal worker preserves fixed/major erasure parameters, and a wrapper preserves the original public binder order and kinds.

currentLimitation.affectedWhen: Changing-parameter normalization renames original parameters, including fixed record parameters.
currentLimitation.cause: Dotted references rooted at those parameters survive while their binders receive hygienic internal names.
currentLimitation.compatibilityForm: Historical A workaround: use a typed branch-local alias of the original record parameter and project the alias.

acceptance: Preserve exact local/global qualified-name priority and the existing first-segment path, including a selected field chain whose typing fails.
Resolve the complete multi-segment hygienic base and chained field suffixes with no global-prefix expansion or magic-name exemption.
Respect resolved parameter identity and let/lambda/pattern shadowing.
Cover both fixed record parameters and generalized record state.
Keep exact identity helpers unchanged and retain refusals when projected values would masquerade as unchanged whole parameters or constructor children.
Preserve public binder order/kinds, structural provenance, simultaneous arguments and existing dependent/recursive-escape refusals.
Keep implementation source compilable by selected A while repaired native/generated compilers consume ordinary raw projection examples.
Review the whole affected reference class, then require focused runtime/original-IR evidence, exact-current-source C2/C3 equality and independent provider receipts.
Select a qualified compiler that accepts the new authored form before removing compatibility aliases from compiler source.

design.sharedResolver: Return an untyped resolved base and remaining field suffix from Term.lean; use the same selection policy in projection elaboration and parameter-reference rewriting.
design.recursionEnvironment: Thread immutable PsEnvironment through the recursion walk/normalizer.
priority: Resolve the complete exact local/global name first.
Otherwise preserve an existing first-segment local/global projection base whenever it resolves.
Only an absent first-segment base permits the longest proper multi-segment LOCAL prefix.
Type the selected base and field chain once; do not retry lookup after a field-typing error.
prohibitedExpansion: projection-base identity in unchanged-argument or constructor-child classification
design.exactIdentityRule: These helpers remain exact-only; state.field cannot inherit the identity of state.
design.parserBoundary: Raw binders have one segment; the longer local-prefix path handles complete multi-segment hygienic names.

currentLimitation.consumerCheckpoint: F removes only three named aliases after the R qualification/recovery/selection prerequisite; its implementation and qualification are recorded separately.

capabilities.proposal: Pure immutable state records and Except/Option values; preserve first-error and state-on-error policy; reuse foundation helpers.
Nat, Int, Bool, Char, String, Unit with original exact arithmetic and Unicode/UTF-8 semantics.

Report original IR first; enforce scope, arity, layouts, primitive signatures, runtime type closure and import closure once inventoried. Include literal/result-type and selected scalar range/width invariants.

observed.countsMeaning: The original C2/C3 reports contain only the 244 expression-typing category; absent categories are recorded here as zero because traversal completed.

initialC1.interpretation: Old Q produces C1's full-source IR; the C1 executable already contains the repair.

nextBoundedWork: Retain the separately earned TS5 and current-TS7 native/generated/runtime/compiler/provider checkpoints without relabeling historical inventories.

R2's paired new-only ps-0.9-r3 grammar and parameter-projection repair are compiler-qualified, provider-accepted, cold-recovered and explicitly selected. Apply and qualify the coherent F candidate using that authenticated seed; retain F's own source/runtime/provider evidence boundary.
Keep checked emission of the exact inspected IR, pre-emission refusal of malformed/incomplete input, and bounded development gates as regression contracts for future source milestones.
Close the remaining enabled primitive/value, bounds/text-position, layout and erasure/backend correspondence requirements before strict SH/1 promotion.
Keep optional scalar, import ABI and empty-layout/match refusals explicit until the applicable capability is specified and qualified.

completedBoundedWork.implementation: Preserve ordered current-declaration generic arguments across runtime/proof binders and restore them during recursive-IH reconstruction.
completedBoundedWork.scope: Declaration generics only; no collection of unrelated local type bindings and no declaration-name exemptions.

capabilities.historicalInventoryMeaning: The existing observed, previousObserved and observedHistory objects retain pre-M6 diagnostic executions. Their counts are not portable-checker acceptance results.

capabilities.proposal: Use the same typed plan for supported equations, leading lets and aliases; preserve constraints, scope and structural provenance.
capabilities.currentSourceGrammar: ps-0.9-r3 supports a declaration's single-term brace wrapper as syntax; general leading-let/equation normalization remains a separate semantic extension.

capabilities.proposal: Infer omitted binder type only from a known expected function domain; do not promise unrestricted inference or later-argument constraint propagation.
capabilities.currentSourceGrammar: Grouped typed lambda/callback syntax is supported in current .ps; it does not enable omitted binder-domain inference.

capabilities.proposal: Authoring pattern tree lowers to flat factored matches; first-clause/default/scope/exhaustiveness preserved.

Optional future expected-type-directed Except-only sugar with independently qualified meaning. Current .ps keeps explicit typed helper calls; it never reinterprets the historical compilerBind/compilerPure DSL as generic do.
Retain compatible support; prefer total indexing; document copy-on-update cost; no mutable-vector promise.
Fixed-width/floating/word-sized operations require explicit capability semantics and target conformance; no full language claim from an IR enum.
Integrate one coherent target API at a time; preserve original TS-to-JS minimum lane.

stages.name: Bounded authoring conveniences

stages.sourceGrammarTransition: Current new-only .ps grammar is independent of moving handwritten compiler source authority from .lean to .ps.

minimumExecutingIdentity.persistentResults: Exact executing implementation digest and complete stage inputs; reuse across sessions only through supported serialization.
minimumExecutingIdentity.inMemorySnapshots: Exact generated compiler import/session identity, in addition to implementation identity.

cacheContract.invalidation: First changed module through semantic suffix until complete state equality is established; import-only invalidation is insufficient.

emission.granularity: Whole prepared closure until independent module emission is implemented.

cacheContract.authority: Cache receipts do not create checked provider handles.
cacheContract.failures: Missing/corrupt entries recompute; timeout/cancellation/exhaustion remain operational, not permanent semantic invalidity.

concurrentWork.policy: Reuse accepted provider/fast-path work; do not duplicate or modify kernel/provider implementation in this language proposal.

currentGenerationContract.identicalInput: Same exact raw current authored source A; repeat for migrated source B.
currentGenerationContract.equality: Canonical source, ordered admissions, TS and JS products of C1(A) versus C2(A), associated with C2 versus C3.
currentGenerationContract.oldSeedBoundary: C1 versus C2 compiler artifacts may differ.
currentGenerationContract.receipts: Record each execution separately; provenance fields are not required to be byte equal.
afterSeedPromotion: Q is the pinned qualified compiler from A
currentGenerationContract.currentSourceMeaning: After selecting Q from A, the B symbol in the executable equation denotes each exact current authored source checkpoint, including H, E and the bounded M6 runtime-typing implementation.
currentGenerationContract.inventoryMeaning: A generation receipt describes IR produced by its executing compiler. Preserve historical E inventories separately. A pinned pre-checker Q may produce C1's legacy report while the new C1 executable exercises M6; later current-source reports require the portable checker. Legacy inventory never grants runtime IR typing acceptance.
currentGenerationContract.definitionsApplyTo: The historical initial A qualification before selecting Q; afterSeedPromotion defines later current-source checkpoints.
currentGenerationContract.toolchainMeaning: Compare C2/C3 within one exact current profile. TS7 current qualification and TS5 historical seed recovery have separate CLI/option identities; neither cross-version JS equality nor inherited TS5 acceptance is assumed.
currentGenerationContract.sourceGrammarMeaning: Current .ps products carry the ps-0.9-r3 identity. Historical selected-A products retain their producer's grammar at the old-seed boundary. New current C2/C3 canonical source hashes must match the N1 captured-closure correspondence artifact; old/new canonical bytes are not assumed equal.
afterProjectionSeedPromotion: R is the exact qualified, recoverable, explicitly selected projection-capable compiler.
All executions read the same exact raw F source; compare the four declared C2/C3 products within the current pinned profile.
currentGenerationContract.migrationAbiMeaning: F's synchronous ABI hook reads the existing prepared declarations and exact IR before original-IR checking/emission. It prepares only an isolated signature/typed-partial module, not another full baseline closure; no probe declaration enters the authoritative compiler.

authoringSeed.prerequisite: Qualified, source-recoverable, explicitly selected projection-capable R successor
authoringSeed.evidenceScope: R authoring prerequisite only; F sourceRef, runtime/ABI/provider results and qualification remain pending.

contracts.completePublicTypes: preserved; actual prepared Core types compared with independent isolated signatures
contracts.zeroFuelAndScanPolicies: retain each worker's existing policy and limits
contracts.stateAndErrorBehavior: preserve collision/lookup order, accumulator reversal, first errors, wrappers and scope updates

behavior.plan: Authenticate selected R and F compiler identities, construct owner-local values, assert independent expectations, then compare JSON observations.

gates.promotion: One coherent current-source F qualification, checked original IR, C2/C3 canonical-source/admissions/TS/JS equality, and separate exact-stream provider acceptance.

proofScriptPreparation.realCompilerEvidence: Existing q sessionConformance proofScript request; pending F execution

resources.maxSteps: Separate whole-input preflight and dispatcher allowances; every input/list occurrence is visited, and each individual string has an initial-fuel UTF-8 size bound.
resources.maxTypeSteps: Per type well-formedness, equality or simultaneous substitution operation.
resources.maxFindings: Retained diagnostic detail cap; total failed-obligation count and dispatcher traversal continue.
resources.visitedSteps: Completed preflight plus dispatcher steps; excludes internal type/lookup operations, and failed preflight returns zero.
resources.exhaustion: Reject with incomplete traversal; never accept unchecked input at zero fuel.
resources.countsMeaning: Failed checking obligations; a type operation reports its first error rather than every malformed descendant.
resources.limitsMeaning: Bounded work scopes, not a single wall-clock, total-byte or allocation budget.

hostBoundary.carrierChecks: Current compiler-instance constructor ownership, supported scalar carriers, malformed/cyclic input and carrier resource limits.
hostBoundary.semanticChecker: Portable Ps.CompilerIr.Check only; host serializes reports.
hostBoundary.cappedPerCodeCounts: findingCountsCoverage is retained-details-only when finding details were omitted.

boundedBackendRepair.scope: Preserve the old binding in a same-named let initializer, including suspended calls and closure capture, while the body uses the new binding.
boundedBackendRepair.implementation: Use a generator-parameter boundary when the conservative name-use scan detects the initializer reference; refuse that case in direct tail-loop batching.
boundedBackendRepair.preservationClaim: Focused behavior evidence only; no general lowering-preservation proof.

sameSourceTypeScriptComparison.timingScope: One direct CLI compilation observation per profile of the same complete emitted compiler TypeScript source. Each elapsedMs is the profile report's phases[].compile.elapsedMs. This comparison does not establish whole-pipeline speedup, repeat-run variance, or cross-version artifact equality.
fieldsUnavailableFromCompletedLog: full per-profile diagnostics and command receipts

sourceGrammarCheckpoint.historicalRecovery: Immutable S0/A revisions, source grammars, TypeScript 5.8.3 profiles and products remain recoverable.
